test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 

Constructive thinking should be developed through ______ reading.
solution:
The correct answer is **"extensive"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the meaning of the given word:

__
 
• **Extensive - **having wide or considerable extent
 
• Constructive thinking should be developed through*** extensive*** reading.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will learn the other words with meanings:

 
• **Avid - **characterized by enthusiasm and vigorous pursuit : very eager and enthusiastic 
 
• **Narrow - ** of slender width: a long and narrow room
 
• **Brief - **short in duration, extent, or length: a brief meeting
